name: Help Wanted

description.content: Whenever you damage a Generator, it is compromised.
When any compromised Generator is completed by Survivors:

items: Your successful basic-attack cooldowns are [25%] shorter for [90s].
Generators not being repaired regress at [150%] speed for [90s].

description.content: Up to [3] Generators can be compromised at a time.

quote: "You only think you are in control..." -Springtrap
